content.short: Mystic Forge is a crafting game where players combine elements to discover recipes and win artifacts.
content.description: Mystic Forge is a crafting and discovery game: players combine elements to find recipes nobody has found yet and claim legendary artifacts with a jackpot, earning its MST token. It is playable in World App and Telegram and listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Mystic Forge is a crafting and discovery game with MST rewards, playable as a World App mini app.
